Retrieved 2026-07-20 via Exa web_fetch. Al Jazeera (rotation note: AJ used heavily at weekend; using here for primary quotes/detail only).

US carried out NINTH consecutive night of air strikes on Iran. Iranian media reported explosions in Sirik, Jask, Tabriz, Chabahar, Konarak, Bandar Mahshahr, Bandar Imam Khomeini, Khvormuj (Bushehr). Tabriz struck for FIRST time since escalation began. CENTCOM targeted command centres, air defence, coastal surveillance, maritime capabilities, missile/drone launch sites, communications networks. US confirmed death of a THIRD soldier in recent days.

IRGC retaliation: launched missiles from Lorestan province at US bases across region. IRGC said it struck US aircraft at Jordan's Aqaba airport, claimed destroyed hangars at Muwaffaq Salti airbase in Azraq, hit US facilities at Ali Al Salem airbase Kuwait. Sirens in Bahrain.

IRGC said two oil tankers attempting to transit "exploded" while using an "unsafe" corridor, under US coercion. IRGC: "This passage is unsafe for the transport of chemical fertiliser or even a single drop of oil and gas" — corridor unsafe as long as US operations continue.

CENTCOM said Sunday it redirected six commercial vessels and disabled another to ensure "full compliance" with its blockade.

QUOTE - Trump (to reporters in Washington after returning from World Cup final): "We hit them very hard again tonight, and we did that in honour of the, probably three, it's probably three great patriots." Added "we feel very badly" about deaths; "Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon."

QUOTE - Rubio (to reporters in Philippines): US still open to diplomacy but "it has to be real"; urged "other countries" to "step up" to protect shipping, whether by "hardware or finances."

Context: Conflict began when US and Israel attacked Iran on 28 Feb 2026; has killed thousands, mostly in Iran and Lebanon.
